goal: Reconstruct source-observed date-distinct visit groups without arbitrary 20-row pseudo-repeat normalization; preserve method missingness explicitly and verify source-positive site-species OR.

input.source: Mizsei and Wenner (2025), Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.15044115; CC BY 4.0

grain.native_csv_row: Original observation row; not established independent physical trap/visit.
grain.composite_key: surv=site:method:doy exactly 381/381; grouping key may repeat for bottletraps.
grain.date_visit: Recorded distinct site × ISO calendar date: a potential repeat-visit group, NOT proven exchangeable or closure-valid occupancy replicate.
grain.method_day: Site × date × method; all original rows retained and positive evidence combined via Boolean OR (not count summation or ID deduplication).
grain.unrecorded_method: NA / NOT_RECORDED, never 0, never a negative observation.

checks: Native CSV SHA and roster exact, 29 original sites, 381 rows, nine species.
Q1 27 sites/351 native rows/144 source-positive site×species; Q2 13 sites/188 rows/77 positives.
Site×date and site×date×method counts and per-site visit-span distribution in days.
Daily site×date×species OR reconciles losslessly to native site×species recorded positives.
Four-method site-day-status table preserves no-method samples as NA and only derives method-group non-detections when method is recorded.
Every raw native CSV row remains attached to exactly one date+method group, even when the composite key repeats.
Tabulate number of source-positive site×species pairs detected in a single date or method.
Produce SHA-stamped JSON + method×visit×species long CSV + daily×species long CSV, no likelihood or model fitting.
prohibited: Do not infer individual trap identity, independent effort, closure across dates, or ecological occupancy probability.
Do not estimate authors' published unmarked coefficients or causal management effects.
Do not treat missing method as zero, replicate a row, remove conflicting source rows or sum counts across uncertain physical units.
No A/B/M mechanism conclusion, fourth EOG-WF prediction endpoint, or merging Draft PR.
